about: Beacon's routing terms on the V80 (foldsim_beacon_terms.py fit, crossings counted): path delay = intercept + ns_per_level x logic levels + ns_per_log2_fanout x log2 of the path's largest net fanout + ns_slr_crossing x the path's SLR CHANGES (a path through a copy spread over SLRs crosses two or three times: y8r1di's worst paths, 11-07). Fit 11-07 on three V80 builds, 12,000 user-clock paths: b4e's post-route phys_opt checkpoint (4-SM A100-class fold at 5.000 ns, routed WNS -1.970 ns; 6,000 paths over the slack range, f12_1107/cal/bins_routed.tsv), y8r1di's post-place phys_opt checkpoint (8 SMs at 5.000 ns, WNS -3.360; the 3,000 worst paths) and b4ct150's post-place phys_opt checkpoint (4 SMs at 6.667 ns; the 3,000 worst; routed WNS -0.751 ns, 134.8 MHz). Per build (bias = predicted minus measured): b4e rmse 1.06 / bias +0.03 ns, y8r1di 0.80 / -0.36, b4ct150 0.51 / +0.30 (samples.*; the crossing flag of the earlier fit had y8r1di at -1.89). The worst-path samples are truncated in slack, so r2 is quoted over all 12,000 only. `flag` keeps the earlier b4e-only crossing-flag fit.

flag.about: Beacon's routing terms on the V80 (foldsim_beacon_terms.py fit), ROUTED: 6,000 user-clock paths of b4e's post-route phys_opt checkpoint (11-07, 4-SM A100-class fold at 5.000 ns, routed WNS -1.970 ns), up to 500 per slack band from -3 to +5 ns; path delay = 5.0 ns - slack against logic levels, log2 of the path's largest net fanout and whether it changes SLR. At 200 MHz: 11.4 levels with short nets, an SLR crossing ~4.7 levels, a fanout of 8,192 ~6.5 levels.

placed.about: the same fit on b4e's post-place phys_opt checkpoint (6,432 paths)
